{"patches":[{"file":"contract.md","before":"Later rows, including resets, are not processed.","after":"Later rows, including resets, are not processed.

## Reporting clarifications (review T2/T4/T5; documentation only, no semantic change)
- T2 row numbering on termination: for the epoch closed with reason terminated_unjudgeable_dut_output, pending_alternatives.closed_at and the cycle of the pending_at_unjudgeable_row record are the last processed row (c-1). counts.termination_boundary is the unjudged row c, where judgment terminated on undefined DUT control output. The closed state is the explicit history set at the end of row c-1, which is the start of row c. closed_at must not be read as the terminated row. If the undefined DUT control output occurs before any reset, there is no active epoch, so no closure record is emitted.
- T4 counts.checked_scope.rows_beyond_input_boundary: despite its name, this is total_rows_in_trace - processed_rows, i.e. the number of unprocessed rows. It applies at either boundary: the first invalid-input boundary (counts.input_validity_boundary) or the termination boundary (counts.termination_boundary). It is nonzero on the termination path even when input_validity_boundary is null. A row that fails schema or validity checks, or that terminates on undefined DUT control output, is not processed and is included. A row in which an environment violation is detected during processing counts as processed and is not included. The field name is unchanged.
- T5 counts.clause_scope.<clause>.unknown_tag_records: this counts only entries in the unresolved list whose item is one of the classified tag kinds. Those kinds are post_abort_forward and unexplained_mapped_err (K9 and K8), possible_starvation_err and starvation_attributed (K6), and same_edge_response_after_abort (K13). Every flush that contributes such entries is included: reset, batch end, pre-suspension, valid-prefix boundary and termination. It excludes pending_at_batch_end, pending_at_unjudgeable_row, unresolved_on_limit, mixed_same_edge, unjudgeable_row and unclassified tags, as well as counts.discarded_epoch_evidence (refuted-history disclosure, not in the unresolved list). It is a historical count of unknown-class tag records. It is not the total of unresolved diagnostics, not a clause status (see property_status) and not coverage."}],"rationale":["T2: closure is called with the last processed row, while termination_boundary names the unjudged row; this documents the existing behavior so consumers do not misread closed_at.","T4: the field is computed as total minus processed rows on both boundary paths; it is documented rather than renamed, so code and metric output stay unchanged.","T5: unknown_tag_records filters the unresolved list on the classified tag map; its exact inclusions and exclusions are stated to prevent it being read as total unresolved diagnostics or as coverage.","Text is inserted after the unique N1/N2 sentence only. All existing assumptions, exclusions (K5, C1-C4, F1-F8, HR ERRs unknown, rule 3.05), non-proof claims and candidate status remain unchanged. This change does not freeze, replay or authorize B/C."],"contract_decisions":[]}
